# Clerk Operations

_Discovery source: [Clerk's language-model documentation index](https://clerk.com/docs/llms.txt)_

Use this reference for environment variables, instances, domains, redirects, deployment, testing, troubleshooting, Dashboard configuration, or SDK upgrades.

## Operating Guidance

- Keep development and production instances separate, with the same environment key names and stage-specific values.
- Verify allowed origins, redirect URLs, domains, webhook endpoints, and credentials in the provider dashboard as part of runtime completion.
- Use testing tokens and provider-supported test paths instead of weakening production security controls for automation.
- During upgrades, inspect installed versions and migration guidance, then validate both browser flow and protected server behavior.
